snippet.title: Dverghold: Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
⚒️ Dwarf Home: Dverghold is a classic old-school dungeon crawler inspired by Dungeon Master and Orcs & Elves, with a dark Dungeon Synth soundtrack and deep base-building mechanics. NOTE: This game is still in early development/pre-Alpha.

📱 Designed for handheld play—not mobile slop. No ads. No grind. Just one full game unlock after the free demo.

🗡️ Explore ancient dungeons, gather resources, and reclaim the dwarves’ home from an evil necromancer. Brutal fantasy the way it used to be, no coffeshops in this dungeon.

🎮 Coming first to mobile, with expanded PC and console versions planned.

www.kvlt.games

Support our crowdfunder: 
https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/hyper-rebellion-blood-circuits/x/38643006#/
